headline: It reads your whole project, then shows the one part that matters.

figure.fits: A magnifying glass: the rim and handle are everything Vyo reads in a project, and the glass is the one part it brings up close.

texts.text: **Under the glass:** the reader, the biggest part of Vyo. It goes through every file before anything is drawn.
The rim is everything Vyo reads. The glass is the one part it brings up close.

notes.title: What it reads
notes.text: Vyo goes through every file and folder in a project and counts its lines. It finds the screens, the saved records and the outside services the code uses.

notes.title: What it brings close
notes.text: You choose the one part the project is about. Vyo draws it in the accent colour, so it is the first thing a person sees.

notes.title: What you get
notes.text: A poster as a PNG and a PDF. Before it writes them, Vyo checks the words for jargon, file paths and text that runs into the picture.

notBuilt: any format but PNG and PDF
